provider: Mille Lacs County, Minnesota — County GIS
selection: Two layers of the public Utilities MapServer were queried with where=1=1 (no spatial or attribute filter), outFields=* and returnGeometry=true, in the service's native spatial reference (ESRI:103705). Layer 1 (Gas Pipelines) is out of scope and was not captured. No clipping, reprojection, or attribute pruning was applied to the captured response bytes.
capture_method: curl -sS '<source_url>' -o <path>; the committed files are the unmodified HTTP response bodies for the layer_query_url values below.
license_access: The MapServer publishes no reusable license. The service-level copyrightText is 'Mille Lacs County MN' (both layers' layer-level copyrightText is empty). Retain that attribution and verify terms with Mille Lacs County GIS before redistribution.

verification.method: Both layer_query_url values were re-fetched from the live service and compared byte-for-byte with the committed capture files; both count_query_url values were fetched to confirm the captures are complete for the queried layers.

coverage.reason: The service publishes no authoritative count of in-scope transmission lines or substations, so the returned feature counts are observations, not denominators. Scope is Mille Lacs County only; this is not countywide utility completeness and not a Minnesota statewide inventory.

connectivity: No terminals and no connectivity edges were created. The source supplies geometry and attributes only; the artifact leaves both arrays empty rather than inferring electrical topology.
uncertainty: Positional precision is unpublished in the queried layer metadata, so geometry_precision_m is null on every asset. maxRecordCount for this service is 1000 and both captures are far below it, so no exceededTransferLimit truncation applies to these captures.
